key_insight: CIDERS formulates cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a personalized bilevel optimization problem, balancing cloud-wide consensus with edge-specific adaptation through a consensus-variate correction strategy.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical framework for deploying LLMs across cloud-edge systems where shared knowledge must be continuously personalized without sacrificing global coordination.
method: Splits the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger for efficient cloud-edge transfer.
Uses bilevel optimization: edge-side personalization at the upper level and cloud-side knowledge transfer at the lower level.
Injects global trajectory information into local updates via consensus-variate correction to align personalization with consensus.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong gains on compressed edge benchmarks, including 3.1× on mathematical reasoning, 1.7× on code generation, and a 10% relative improvement on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds algorithmic complexity and may require careful tuning to preserve the intended trade-off between personalization quality and convergence stability.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
